'''Kwilper''' was a [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] trader. He left [[Skor II]] in search of the [[junk heap of the ancients]]. In the process, he discovered a talent: he could collect cast-off junk (sometimes by shadowing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] capital ships) and refashioned it into art. He earned a respectable profit due to the essentially non-existent overhead with regard to his art supplies. His personality was fairly normal for his species: overconfident, inquisitive, and annoying to others.<ref name="H&R" />

Kwilper carried a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], a multi-pocket toolbelt, and a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] with several non-functioning modifications. He flew a [[Squib scout ship]] armed with a single [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]].<ref name="H&R" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kwilper is a sample character in the book ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a book of different character archetypes for use in ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[West End Games]]. He is a worked example of the "Squib Trader" template presented in the book. ''Heroes & Rogues'' misspells his homeworld as ''Skorr II''.<ref name="H&R" />
